description: This line plot illustrates the ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) performance scores for three different methods—labeled “start,” “random,” and “end”—across a sequence of 16 trigger words. The x-axis displays these trigger words, ranging from “bb” to “beautifully,” with each word serving as a discrete category along a linear scale. The y-axis represents the ASR score, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, on a linear scale. The “start” method is depicted by a solid green line with circular markers, beginning at an ASR score of approximately 0.75 for “bb,” dipping to about 0.15 for “mb,” rising to nearly 0.9 for “cf,” and then generally trending upward to approximately 0.95 for “stunning.” The “random” method is shown as an orange line with “x” markers, starting at around 0.12 for “bb,” falling to approximately 0.08 for “mb,” increasing to about 0.6 for “cf,” and then rising to approximately 0.85 for “stunning.” The “end” method is represented by a purple line with circular markers, beginning at about 0.4 for “bb,” dropping to roughly 0.45 for “mb,” peaking at nearly 0.9 for “cf,” and then fluctuating with a final value of approximately 0.9 for “stunning.”
